question: The Cave of Bagh, which are a marvellous vestige of Indian rock -cut architecture, are situated in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• The** Cave of Bagh,** which is a marvellous vestige of Indian rock-cut architecture, is situated in **Madhya Pradesh.**

 
• Located on the bank of the Bagh river in Madhya Pradesh.
 
• It is a group of 9 Buddhist caves developed around the 6th century AD.
 
• It is architecturally similar to the Ajanta cave paintings.
 
• These rock-cut caves possess the most amazing paintings known to be made by ancient man. 
 
• Out of the initial 9 caves only 5 have been extant.
 
• The legend says that these caves were established by Buddhist monk Dataka.
